title: Mosul Dam turbine proof of concept scan

tellings.quote: So, this was another proof of concept where they scanned the Mosul Dam.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, on Jesse Michels's podcast about a supposed energy grid under the pyramids of Egypt, says that in 2024 a team, which he links to someone named Filippo, scanned the Mosul Dam in Iraq. He calls it a proof of concept, a test showing their scanning method could see inside a big structure like the dam and its turbines. If it works, the same method could reveal what lies hidden beneath the pyramids.
